screening_decisions.reason: Randomized allocation in adults with frozen shoulder comparing intraarticular steroids, mobilisations (manual therapy), ice, and no treatment; all taught pendular exercises. Meets RCT criteria with manual therapy/exercise in adhesive capsulitis.
Observational general practice incidence/management study across multiple shoulder disorders; not an RCT intervention trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Educational/principles article on joint mobilization; not a clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis.

Open RCT comparing physical therapies alone versus physical therapies plus shoulder arthrography with intra-articular steroid. Both arms received similar physical therapies; the trial evaluates steroid/distension rather than the effect of manual therapy/exercise per se.
Methodological review on RCT reporting versus protocols; not an intervention study in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized controlled trial in idiopathic adhesive capsulitis evaluating deep transverse friction massage (manual therapy) and capsular stretching (exercise). Matches population and interventions.

Randomly allocated adults with frozen shoulder to two supervised exercise programs (with/without scapulothoracic exercises); compares exercise regimens. Meets RCT criteria for exercise in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized multiple-treatment trial comparing mobilization techniques (ERM, MRM, MWM) in frozen shoulder syndrome. Manual therapy comparison in the target population.

Trial comparing PNF movement patterns versus conventional free exercises in chronic peri-arthritis/frozen shoulder; exercise-focused in target condition. Randomization not explicitly stated in abstract—include conservatively.
Pilot randomized trial (block randomization) comparing AP vs PA glides (manual therapy mobilizations) in adhesive capsulitis. Fits RCT criteria.
Population prevalence/impact study of upper limb musculoskeletal disorders; not an RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
Multiple-subject case report on end-range mobilization; not randomized/quasi-randomized.

Placebo-controlled RCT in adhesive capsulitis comparing supervised physiotherapy (exercise) and/or intraarticular corticosteroid and placebo. Tests the effect of physiotherapy (exercise) versus placebo/control within frozen shoulder.

Randomized, participant- and assessor-blinded trial of manual therapy and directed exercise versus sham ultrasound following glenohumeral joint distension in adhesive capsulitis; evaluates adjunct physiotherapy. Meets criteria.
Measurement/psychometric responsiveness study (SDQ) in primary care shoulder disorders; not an RCT of manual therapy/exercise in adhesive capsulitis.
Comparative study of acupuncture, physical therapy, and combination without clear randomization; appears nonrandomized. Exclude per RCT/quasi-RCT criterion.
Systematic review and cost-effectiveness analysis of frozen shoulder management; not a primary RCT.

Study comparing anterior vs posterior glide mobilizations for internal rotation in adhesive capsulitis; randomization not specified in abstract but appears comparative manual therapy in target population—include conservatively.
Meta-research on outcome reporting bias in RCTs; not a clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Abstract content unrelated to adhesive capsulitis (MS cohort); even by title, heating modalities are not manual therapy/exercise per protocol focus.
Randomized clinical trial comparing corticosteroid injection, physiotherapy, and combination in frozen shoulder; includes a physiotherapy (exercise) arm relevant to the review.

Randomized trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing Cyriax approach (deep friction massage + mobilization exercises) to conventional physical therapy; manual therapy and exercise interventions directly compared.
Prospective natural history study; not an interventional RCT.
Methods paper on heterogeneity metrics in meta-analysis; not a clinical trial.
Methodological chapter on reporting biases; not an interventional trial in adhesive capsulitis.
Prospective natural history/observational study of frozen shoulder; not a randomized or quasi-randomized trial of manual therapy/exercise.
Adults with adhesive capsulitis; randomized to mobilization+active exercises vs active exercises alone. RCT of manual therapy/exercise.
Adults with adhesive capsulitis randomized to sodium hyaluronate injection, steroid injection, physical therapy modalities, or control. Contains a physical therapy arm and randomized design.
Electromyographic study of shoulder muscle activity; not an RCT in adhesive capsulitis and not testing manual therapy/exercise effectiveness.
Comparative study in broad chronic shoulder pain population (not specific to adhesive capsulitis); includes nerve block and injections; does not meet AC population criterion.
Adults with adhesive capsulitis randomized to corticosteroid injection vs physical therapy measures (with NSAIDs). RCT with a physiotherapy arm.
Methods chapter on interpreting results; not a clinical trial.
Retrospective study comparing treatments; not randomized and not an RCT or quasi-RCT.
Randomized controlled study comparing Mulligan’s vs Maitland’s mobilization in adhesive capsulitis; manual therapy comparison.
Methods chapter on presenting results; not a clinical trial.
Population-based epidemiology of shoulder pain; not an interventional RCT in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized comparison of iontophoresis vs phonophoresis vs placebo in ‘shoulder periarthritis’; no manual therapy or exercise arm described.

Randomized, observer-blind trial in painful stiff shoulder/periarthritis comparing local steroid, physiotherapy, or both. Likely corresponds to adhesive capsulitis terminology; includes physiotherapy arm.
Frozen shoulder RCT: electroacupuncture+exercise or interferential electrotherapy+exercise vs no treatment. Includes shoulder exercises within intervention.
Adhesive capsulitis RCT comparing ibuprofen+physical therapy vs ibuprofen alone; tests effectiveness of physical therapy.
Randomized trial in chronic adhesive capsulitis: both groups receive exercises+ultrasound; experimental adds end-range mobilization. Manual therapy/exercise study.
Randomized clinical trial in adhesive capsulitis comparing anterior vs posterior glide mobilization; all receive concurrent modalities/exercise. Manual therapy focus.
Randomized 4-arm trial in adhesive capsulitis: triamcinolone and/or standardized physiotherapy vs placebos; all with home exercise program. Meets design and intervention.
Prospective randomized comparison in adhesive capsulitis: manipulation under anesthesia, peri-articular injection, and physiotherapy. Includes manual therapy/exercise arms.
Systematic review of interventions; not a primary RCT.
Methods chapter on meta-analysis; not a clinical trial.

Title indicates randomized controlled study of joint mobilization versus self-exercises in adhesive capsulitis (LGHM). Although abstract wording is observational, err on inclusion due to RCT indication and relevant interventions.
Prospective systematically allocated (quasi-randomized) clinical trial comparing chiropractic manipulation+exercise vs mobilization+exercise in adhesive capsulitis.
Randomized controlled trial comparing high-grade vs low-grade mobilizations in adhesive capsulitis; manual therapy focus.
Single-blind randomized pilot: passive joint mobilization added to home-care after corticosteroid injection versus home-care alone in adhesive capsulitis.
